title: NAV-anchored exit floor lets an unprivileged actor cheaply revert a pending exit, skim, or totalWithdrawal Phase-2 by front-running with a Curve pool dump (transient griefing)
description: minOut = convertToAssets(shares) * (1 - slippageToleranceBps) is anchored to sUSDe NAV while the AMM exit price sits below NAV; live headroom is ~23.8 bps under B = 30. An unprivileged actor holding capital can front-run a public-mempool exit, skim or totalWithdrawal Phase-2 with a Curve pool dump that pushes output under the floor; the victim tx reverts and the attacker unwinds.
impact: None to assets: a transient, atomic revert. The attacker pays ~101 sUSDe (~$127) round-trip at a 250k sUSDe dump and gains nothing; capital must be held across the bundle (the original 'not flash-loanable' claim is unverified and likely false; see flashLoanNote). The victim retries or uses a private relay. MUST NOT be framed as a value leak or solvency issue (doNotReRaise).
attackPath: The victim's exit/skim/Phase-2 tx is in the public mempool.
The attacker front-runs with a Curve pool dump pushing output below NAV x (1 - B).
The victim's tx reverts on minOut; the attacker unwinds at a cost.
evidence: Fork probe work/test/scan-run18/LiveAdapterFork.t.sol::test_frontRunDumpRevertsExitAndCost PASS: 10k/50k/100k sUSDe dumps -> exit succeeds; 250k -> REVERTS at ~101 sUSDe cost; 500k -> ~9,286 sUSDe; 1M -> ~129,588 sUSDe.
MR-003 donation variant refuted on cost (~0.24% of sUSDe totalAssets, ~$2.8M gifted).

priorTriageDisclosure.M-02 d7f6c2dfd580: M-02 d7f6c2dfd580 (false-positive, 2026-06-09) triageNote: "The use of convertToShares/convertToAssets is intentional — the design allows in-block swaps without MEV fear precisely because the AMM pool is concentrated liquidity. A small slippage tolerance covers 99% of deposit/withdrawal scenarios. The NAV reference is not exploitably skewed in this pool topology. No valid attack path."
priorTriageDisclosure.M-02-run11 c7329862eb0e: M-02-run11 c7329862eb0e (false-positive) suppressionReason: "donation to sUSDe is genuine non-recoverable yield (value-positive, self-defeating as attack). Deposit-DoS direction is backwards (higher share price lowers minOut). Withdraw-DoS requires the AMM/vault price to decouple and stay decoupled — closed by arbitrage and prevented by the NG rate oracle."
priorTriageDisclosure.whyNotCovered: M-02 was closed as a VALUE-LEAK (sandwich) framing — 'no MEV fear', 'no valid attack path' to extract value; QA-13 claims no extraction at all, only a same-bundle revert. M-02-run11 was closed as a PERSISTENT Withdraw-DoS that 'requires the AMM/vault price to decouple and stay decoupled — closed by arbitrage'; QA-13 needs no persistent decouple: a same-bundle push is reverted before any arbitrageur can act. Neither closure's rationale addresses a transient revert-grief, so this is re-filed at QA with disclosure, not re-raised in either closed framing.

recommendation: Operational: route exits/skims/totalWithdrawal Phase-2 through a private relay; document that a revert at the floor is expected protection. Prefer private submission to raising slippageToleranceBps (raising B is the L-01/ECON-002 footgun trigger).
escalationTrigger: LOW/MEDIUM if a revert can be made to consume a one-shot or time-bounded resource (e.g. Phase-2 state reset before the swap without revert atomicity, or a V2 initiateMigration that cannot be retried privately).
Interacts with L-01/ECON-002: repeated griefing pressures the owner to raise B, which is the CLASS-18-04 footgun trigger.
flagForHuman: Owner previously rejected MEV framings on this path; confirm a QA-level revert-grief note is wanted (borderline QA vs drop).
validityConcern: leaning drop — transient retriable revert; meaningful content (pressure to raise B) cross-referenced into L-01 annotation
flashLoanNote: Morpho Blue flash-loan note (run-18 validity-review): the impact's 'not flash-loanable' claim is unverified and likely false — Morpho Blue flashLoan lends any token it holds, including sUSDe collateral. That lowers the attacker's capital requirement but adds no profit; the grief remains transient and unprofitable, so the verdict (QA) does not change.

revisionHistory.change: Kept at QA (Law 1: no silent drop); validityConcern + Morpho Blue flash-loan note added.
